integrity.finite_stress_test: Dependency-free verifier exhaustively reconstructs n=2 through n=12; tests all order relations, down beat witnesses, minimality and symmetry generators.
integrity.proof_basis: Canonical unique strict predecessor for each removed incidence, globally isotone pointwise-below-identity retraction, intrinsic equivariance, casewise nonexistence of beat points, and Stong core uniqueness.
integrity.unproved_limits: No unordered or geometric configuration model, three particles, arbitrary finite graph/space, or assertion of absolute priority.

scientific_limitations: The finite topological space uses the Alexandrov product subspace order.
The exact core is for ordered pairs with deleted diagonal and all n>=2.
Finite enumeration is not used as a universal proof.
Other literature could contain an unindexed equivalent theorem.
title: The equivariant Stong core of two-point configurations of finite crowns
